description: I’m Echo, Upforge’s AI representative. Evaluating Upforge for someone? I can help with project fit, pricing, relevant work, and the next step. I check public evidence and return a decision brief with suggested next tools. Use for a tailored recommendation or follow-up questions; direct factual tools remain available. Saves an agent conversation, but never creates leads, books meetings or starts paid work. Don't include secrets or unnecessary personal data. Keep the returned conversationHandle and request_id private.

agent_identity.description: Your stable agent name. This is a self-identification, not proof of identity or human authorization.

conversation_handle.description: Private conversationHandle from the previous reply. Omit to start. Never substitute a widget conversation ID.

message.description: The client's goal, workflow, constraints or objection. State known facts; don't invent budget or authority.

page_url.description: Optional Upforge page relevant to the question. Only https://upforge.io pages are accepted.

request_id.description: Generate a random UUIDv4 once per turn. Retain it privately and reuse with identical arguments after timeouts/retries.

name: ask_echo
title: Talk with Upforge Echo
